    input   [ 31: 0] MonDReg;

    input            clk;
    input            dbrk_hit0_latch;
    input            dbrk_hit1_latch;
    input            dbrk_hit2_latch;
    input            dbrk_hit3_latch;
    input            debugack;
    input            monitor_error;

    input            reset_n;

    input            tracemem_on;
    input   [ 35: 0] tracemem_trcdata;
    input            tracemem_tw;
    input   [  6: 0] trc_im_addr;
    input            trc_on;
    input            trc_wrap;
    input            trigbrktype;
    input            trigger_state_1;

    reg    [ 37: 0] sr;
    wire             vji_cdr;
    wire    [  1: 0] vji_ir_in;
    wire    [  1: 0] vji_ir_out;
    wire             vji_rti;
    wire             vji_sdr;
    wire             vji_tck;
    wire             vji_tdi;
    wire             vji_tdo;
    wire             vji_udr;
    wire             vji_uir;

    // Integrate the logic from ddr2_v10_1_sequencer_cpu_jtag_debug_module_tck module
    assign vji_tck = 1'b0;
    assign vji_tdi = 1'b0;
    assign vji_sdr = 1'b0;
    assign vji_cdr = 1'b0;
    assign vji_rti = 1'b0;
    assign vji_uir = 1'b0;
    assign vji_udr = 1'b0;
    assign vji_ir_in = 2'b0;

    assign jrst_n = reset_n & ~resetlatch;
    assign jdo = sr;
    assign st_ready_test_idle = monitor_ready & ~monitor_error;
    assign take_action_break_a = (vji_tdo & dbrk_hit0_latch) | (trigger_state_1 & trigbrktype);
    assign take_action_break_b = (vji_tdo & dbrk_hit1_latch) | (trigger_state_1 & trigbrktype);
    assign take_action_break_c = (vji_tdo & dbrk_hit2_latch) | (trigger_state_1 & trigbrktype);
    assign take_action_ocimem_a = (vji_tdo & dbrk_hit3_latch) | (trigger_state_1 & tracemem_tw);
    assign take_action_ocimem_b = (vji_tdo & debugack);
    assign take_action_tracectrl = (vji_tdo & tracemem_on);
    assign take_action_tracemem_a = (vji_tdo & trc_on);
    assign take_action_tracemem_b = (vji_tdo & trc_wrap);
    assign take_no_action_break_a = ~(vji_tdo & dbrk_hit0_latch);
    assign take_no_action_break_b = ~(vji_tdo & dbrk_hit1_latch);
    assign take_no_action_break_c = ~(vji_tdo & dbrk_hit2_latch);
    assign take_no_action_ocimem_a = ~(vji_tdo & dbrk_hit3_latch);
    assign take_no_action_tracemem_a = ~(vji_tdo & trc_on);

    // Integrate the logic from ddr2_v10_1_sequencer_cpu_jtag_debug_module_sysclk module
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (~reset_n) begin
            sr <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (vji_udr & vji_ir_in == 2'b01) begin
                sr <= MonDReg;
            end else if (vji_udr & vji_ir_in == 2'b10) begin
                sr <= break_readreg;
            end else begin
                sr <= sr;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
